firstTimeGuide.paragraphOpener: If this is your first time adding a page on the VOCALOID Lyrics Wiki, you should note the following:
firstTimeGuide.tip1: Refer to the wiki's "Page Generator Guide" if you're stuck at any point.
firstTimeGuide.tip2: Check out the wiki's "Basics of Editing" Help Page to get started on the wiki's general editing guidelines.
firstTimeGuide.tip3: The wikitext code should be added on Wikitext Source Editor, not Visual Editor. Refer to the section § Editing Basics on our "Basics of Editing" Help page to find this.
firstTimeGuide.tip4: Remember to add redirects to pages to make them more easily searchable on the wiki. For example, when adding a page titled "ハロー・ワールド (Hello World)", you should add a redirect titled "Hello World" to make the song page searchable. Refer to the section § Redirects on our "Basics of Editing" Help page for more information.
